Desk read: The sell-off is Brazil-led: a sliding real (near 5.90) makes Brazilian exports cheaper and pushes Mar toward 17.15, a seven-week low. The only offset is the poor French beet harvest, which tightens EU white supply at the margin but does not change the Centre-South picture.
